description: Is this URL up and set up right? For 1-5 URLs: up or down and why (DNS or connect error, timeout, TLS failure, 5xx), status, response time, redirect chain and final URL, whether http redirects to https, TLS verified, CDN and server, cache policy, and a security-header grade A-F with findings (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking, nosniff). URLs that answer 402 also get their x402 payment terms: networks, assets, amounts, payTo. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.
